status: Implemented and natively sliced; physical coupon confirmation pending
printer: Bambu Lab A1, 256 x 256 x 256 mm

changes.M: Six flat-printed cores with support-free planar keys and six band-free hammered veneers. Veneer seams are independent of core seams. Original rear mounting coordinates and maximum face height retained.
changes.veneer: 1.35–1.90 mm nominal thickness before hidden pockets; .20 mm glue space; three seating pads, one round locator and one axially relieved locator per face panel.
changes.anchors: 4–7 fused rear necks per full panel join a connected sacrificial bed frame. Cross braces where space allows. Tree support is additional; the necks have no slicer contact gap.
changes.finish: Every veneer shares the complete 55-degree/M5 print rotation, including in-plane direction. One continuous hammer field, without band seats or cover bands.
changes.frame: 20 sections / 32 existing seam centerlines. Tested 18 mm lap envelope; three hidden seating stops, .20 mm adhesive relief, internal reservoirs, .80 mm secondary-pocket relief and hidden tongue-tip lead-in.
changes.grain: Compensated per bed rotation. Native comparison checks white, wood and blue top-fill directions at matching heights; the white rail direction is 135 degrees in assembly.
changes.jig: White-face contact pads, 4 mm clearance above the base for texture and 3 mm locating pins. M samples include smooth crown cauls, without hammer dimples, for use with a soft liner and release film.

test_order.purpose: Test exposed seam closure and reflection without bands; assess support cleanup and clamping.
Test structural core fit and whether the veneer seats flat over its joint.
Compare face step, dry closure, surface direction and cured adhesive seam before choosing a production tolerance.

glue_coupon_correction.reason: The previous crop opened one socket and disconnected a chunk of the smaller core half.
glue_coupon_correction.change: Extended the sample 15 mm below the old crop, retaining continuous material around both sockets; regenerated matching seating features, veneer and caul.
glue_coupon_correction.replace: Use all three plates from the updated glue-coupon project together. Earlier glue-coupon parts are superseded.
glue_coupon_correction.verification: All 17 printed test parts have one connected component in both editable and native exported meshes.

assembly_instructions: Keep saved scale, orientations and object settings. Do not auto-orient veneer panels independently.
Use filament slots 1 white, 2 wood tan, 3 copper silk, 4 blue. Full M parts and their fused carriers use copper; sample cauls/jig use white.
Mark part identities on the back before cleanup. Cut the fused necks progressively while supporting the veneer; do not snap the carrier from the face.
Trim the necks inside their recessed rear pockets, leaving no material above the surrounding underside seating plane. Keep the three seating pads and locating features clean.
Assemble the structural core on a flat reference surface. Dry-fit the veneer and check all three seating contacts with gentle clamping before adding adhesive.
Apply a controlled amount of the selected epoxy in the relief regions. Keep the hard stops and cosmetic closing edge free of adhesive.

The white M caul is a removable clamp pad, not part of the artwork. Add a soft liner and release film to its smooth crown face. Use release film on the frame jig. Clamp only enough to seat the veneer; inspect the hammered face after cure.
For the new full M, plates 1–6 are C1–C6 cores; 7–12 are V1–V6 veneers/carriers. The five original cover bands are omitted.
Use the full candidate files after the coupons confirm fit, cleanup, reflection and cupping correction. These digital checks do not establish cured bond strength or invisible seams.
original_solid_M_alternative: The six-plate M-Solid-Common-Orientation-A1-Sliced.3mf retains original solid meshes and support paint. All pieces align with the saved M5 rotation; it does not change the original supported structural construction.
seam_routing: Frame seam centerlines are retained in this controlled comparison; no artwork or blue-edge feature is rerouted. Band-free M veneer seams follow the original five face divisions, with the band seats removed.
